log.msg: Taken: fresh-eyes review of Inbox, Sessions, one session detail, Models at 400/1200/1920/3440; I fix in a worktree myself, no minions unless a fix is big. Plan: shoot (10 min), measure per system (15), fix (30), merge + review.md + land (15)

findings.text: The diff has no review report or links to one (requirements deliverable 3 asks for `review.md` linked from each page's module doc, plus a card report); this file is the independent review, but no module doc in the diff links to it.

The `.page.page--ai` rule in `ai/rail/rail.css:119` depends on the AI page's `name` being `ai` (core stamps `page--<name>`, `Page.class.js:567`). I did not find a literal `page--ai` in source, so check the computed class on `/framework/ai/` before trusting that the chips are hidden at 1920.

`ai/sessions/sessions.css` hides the panel header with a util rule and sets `.sessions-frame` padding in the component layer. This works, but the `Sessions` title is now only in the tab and the rail. That is fine for the one-title rule. The `updated` time moved to the footer line (`AISessionsPage.js:81`), which is a small loss of visibility.

`ModelsPage.js` now draws in a fetch callback instead of after an `await`, which fixes the "no DOM after an await" trap. `live_by_provider` prints as `claude 3, openrouter 2` instead of raw JSON, a clearer reading for the owner. The `wide` class on tables is the only layout change; I did not see 400 or 3440 shots in the diff.

`AISessionDetail.retitle` (`AISessionDetail.js:31`) edits the crumb and column title by querying the DOM. It is guarded, but the title and crumb could be derived from the row up front. A smaller fix would set `title` before `super`, when the row is already known.

decision.what: Hide the core end-of-page chips (open tasks, Inbox · N, AI cost) on the whole AI page, in ai/rail/rail.css
decision.alternative: fold them into a status line like Sessions does; the Inbox already lists what is open, so a second copy was not worth a new component
decision.why: the owner called the same chips useless/out of place on Sessions; they cost 153 px under the rail
